stories.title: Cousins emotional after win in Vikings return, reflects on 'tough three years'
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins was emotional discussing his return to the Vikings after their victory over the Packers.

stories.title: Oklahoma, boosted by crowd's ire at postponement, beats Ole Miss
stories.summary: The Oklahoma crowd let Ole Miss know what they thought of having their game delayed by a day, and the Sooners rode that energy to a 24-17 win over the Rebels.

stories.title: Sources: Lions DE Hutchinson feared to have suffered significant knee injury
stories.summary: Lions star Aidan Hutchinson is feared to have suffered a significant injury to his right knee while celebrating a sack, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: LSU's Fulwiley arrested after allegedly fleeing scene of traffic stop
stories.summary: LSU guard MiLaysia Fulwiley was arrested after she allegedly drove her car into a police vehicle while attempting to flee from a traffic stop.

stories.title: Jets QB Smith suffers ankle injury, replaced by rookie Klubnik
stories.summary: Jets quarterback Geno Smith suffered an ankle injury in the third quarter and was replaced by rookie Cade Klubnik on Sunday at MetLife Stadium.
